Aisha Khan: Maplelane reserved pool bring-up tomorrow 08:30 PT. Need sign-off on steady vs burst allotment and whether to enable route-level soft throttles. @Tom Rivers?
Tom Rivers: I looked at usage patterns. They reserved 48k tokens/min. Recommend baseline 36k (75%) + 12k burst for 48h. Keep KV priming in the plan.
Evan (CSM): Customer ok with 25% buffer but asked that any throttles exclude admin and low-latency paths. They want a 15-min enablement call after first run.
Tom Rivers: I'll run two phases tonight: (1) prefix priming for 20m, (2) 15m steady at 36k, (3) 3m controlled spike to 52k. Small k6 snippet below for spike job.
Tom Rivers: ```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model:'rw-dedicated-13b', prompt:'hi'}), { headers: { 'Authorization':'Bearer $TEST' } });
}
```
load-bot: Job queued by Tom Rivers: job_id=ml-warmup-221, start=2024-04-05T01:00:00Z, runner=k6-3.2
Tom Rivers: Quick note on autoscale: set cool-down to 40s while pool is ramping. If p95 > 250ms for >2min, trigger aggressive scale and enable fallback routing to quantized-variant.
Aisha Khan: Billing note 1: will the temporary headroom change invoicing? Evan: No change to committed quota; we'll tag buffer as "bring-up headroom" and not bill overage during first 48h. Customer accepted.
Evan (CSM): Invite for 15-min walkthrough sent. Also asked customer to fill short post-run survey: https://forms.gle/maplelane-run-feedback
load-bot: Run completed: peak=53k rps (45s), avg=38k, errors=0.9% (429s), p95=245ms. Artifacts: https://internal.redwood/jobs/ml-warmup-221/logs
Tom Rivers: Observed cache hit-rate went 70% -> 90% after priming. Most 429s on non-critical batch endpoints. No 5xx.
Aisha Khan: Action items: (1) apply 40s cooldown, (2) enable soft-throttle on batch routes, (3) schedule reconvene 48h after bring-up for renewal readiness check. Assign @Tom Rivers + @Evan (CSM).
Tom Rivers: Working on throttle rules and tagging metrics for the daily digest. Will also enable fallback routing at 10% traffic to quantized-variant as safety.
Evan (CSM): Noted. I'll prepare the customer health note and remind them about the 15-min call.
Aisha Khan: Thanks all, will check back after 48h. :rocket:
